question: 单项选择：I _____ the book yesterday. A. read  B. have read  C. am reading  D. will read
answer: 答案：A. read。解析：yesterday是一般过去时，read的过去式是read（发音为/red/）。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：I ______ (read) this book already.
answer: 答案：have read。解析：already"已经"是现在完成时标志。

question: 单项选择：_____ you _____ the movie? — Yes, I saw it last night. A. Have, seen  B. Did, see  C. Do, see  D. Are, seeing
answer: 答案：A. Have, seen。解析：现在完成时询问经历。回答用一般过去时saw。

question: 单项选择：I _____ my keys just now. A. have lost  B. lost  C. lose  D. am losing
answer: 答案：B. lost。解析：just now（刚才）是一般过去时。

question: 翻译句子：我昨天看了一部很棒的电影。
answer: 答案：I watched a great movie yesterday. 解析：yesterday是一般过去时。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：He ______ (live) in Beijing for five years, but now he lives in Shanghai.
answer: 答案：lived。解析：for five years + but now提示一般过去时。

question: 单项选择：Have you ever _____ to Japan? A. went  B. gone  C. been  D. go
answer: 答案：C. been。解析：have been to"去过"。ever"曾经"是现在完成时标志。

question: 单项选择：She _____ her homework an hour ago. A. finished  B. has finished  C. finishes  D. is finishing
answer: 答案：A. finished。解析：an hour ago是一般过去时。

question: 翻译句子：我从来没看过这部电影。
answer: 答案：I have never seen this movie. 解析：never"从未"是现在完成时标志。seen是see的过去分词。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：I ______ (visit) my grandparents last weekend. I ______ (visit) them every month.
answer: 答案：visited, visit。解析：last weekend是一般过去时；every month是一般现在时。
